company.shortDescription: Accolade features personalized health and benefits solutions that help to improve experience, outcomes, and healthcare cost for employers.
company.description:
Accolade is a health, wellness, and fitness company that features personalized health and benefits solutions that help to improve the experience, outcomes, and cost of healthcare for employers. It specializes in healthcare process improvement, healthcare savings, employee engagement, and personalized advocacy.

The company was founded in 2007 and headquartered in Plymouth Meeting, Pennsylvania.
